meta_description: Quatrefoil terracotta jali tiles with a square-and-diamond motif for room dividers, indoor columns and airy partitions. Free WhatsApp sample.
description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 004 are a quatrefoil terracotta jali block with a square-and-diamond motif, shown in the product photo stacked into an indoor column, suited to room dividers and partitions that should screen a space without darkening it.

## How it looks
Each block in the photo carries a square-and-diamond, quatrefoil-like opening, and stacked together they form a repeating column of small windows. The motif is decorative but compact, so it tends to work at room scale without feeling heavy. The natural terracotta colour adds warmth against white walls, wood and stone floors.

## Where it works
- **Jali room divider** between a lounge and dining area, or at the edge of an entrance foyer.
- **Indoor terracotta jali column** or a narrow panel beside a stair or doorway.
- **Square and diamond jali block** panels in a courtyard wall or veranda.

Indoors, a clay partition tends to keep a home feeling open: light and air pass through, while the pattern breaks the direct line of sight.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: square-and-diamond (quatrefoil-like) blocks, shown stacked indoors
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before planning the height of a divider.

A free-standing indoor screen usually needs a steel or RCC frame, or bonding into the floor and ceiling, so agree the fixing detail with your contractor. Indoors, dust with a dry brush and wipe with a damp cloth; a breathable clay sealer can make cleaning easier.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your opening size for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), compare [cement and concrete jali](/blog/cement-jali-and-concrete-jali-designs-uses-and-ordering), or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of quatrefoil terracotta jali blocks?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can terracotta jali be used indoors as a room divider?
faqs.a: Yes. Clay jali is often used for partitions between living and dining areas. It needs a frame or proper bonding at floor and ceiling, which your contractor should detail.

faqs.q: Terracotta jali or wooden jali for a partition?
faqs.a: Wooden jali is lighter and can be moved, but it can warp or attract termites. Terracotta is fixed in place and tends to stay stable for years with little upkeep.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 004" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
